One country declines, another prospers, like the sun rising in the morning in the East, then gradually decreasing in the afternoon and setting in the West. We say it disappears but it doesn't mean it completely disappears, it disappears in one place but grows in another. In America when we watch the sun set, it is also dawn in China. It is necessary that all appearances appear like that. When Buddhism came to Western society, our City of Ten Thousand Buddhas was the place of origin - the original base. Last year, old Dharma Master Dong So went to America and went to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. He said that the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas can be compared to Vulture Mountain in India, and it can also be said that the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the Holy City of Buddhism in America. This land also has Dieu Giac Mountain, truly Linh Son Holy City. The topography of Dieu Giac Mountain is like the statue of a person lying down, just waking up from sleep, not only enlightening himself but also taking care of sentient beings in all ten directions, that's why it is called Dieu Giac; Therefore, the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas can be called the Holy City of Giac Son, Holy City of Bodhi, or Holy City of Dieu Giac Son.

When old Dharma Master Do Nguyen came here, he took the few letters of his name "Do Nguyen". (source), put together and say: "The source of the path, the source of the path, the source of the path, the source of the path, the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the source of the practice of all Buddhas in the West." In China, in Guangzhou province, there is "Early Western Hybrid," to remember the place where Patriarch Dharma first set foot in China. Our Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas can also be called "The First Land of the East," But that doesn't mean I'm a "newcomer" - a newcomer. This is saying that old Dharma Master Dong So visited this place, not that your master has just arrived from the East. From now on, at any time and place, it is best not to mention my name. Why? I don't want to be like everyone in the world. You look at Patriarch Bodhidharma, there are no people coming, there are no people leaving, there is nothing. Although it is said that the Patriarch sat at Hung Nhi mountain for nine years, the place where the Patriarch sat is still there, but the people are not. So where is the Patriarch for salvation? No one knows. Therefore, when I was alive, I did not want to use my name. In the future, I will no longer be in this world, and my name will no longer be needed. I often tell you that my name is fake, other names are not real either. Now each of us individually must make vows to be a member of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, that is, no longer someone who just stands on the sidelines and does nothing; If we have the strength, we contribute, if we have money, we spend money, wholeheartedly devoting our efforts, making targeted plans to develop the Ten Thousand Buddhas.

City, do our best to protect the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, protect the place where Western Buddhism originated, this holy land, then the meaning of our valuing the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is over. Our work is not meant to be temporary. In the future, when recording the history of the development of Western Buddhism, this is a point that must be given special attention. It is not that we hope to have a name in this history, we just want the historians of Western Buddhism to write down truthful things. The task at hand is that we don't have to worry about these things, but remember that since we are Buddha disciples at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, we must put all our heart and energy, sweat, tears, and suffering for this project, not be afraid, not retreat, take it for granted, otherwise we are not truly people of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Remember in 1972, I wrote the article "White Universe," Finally, there are two sentences: "Flowing blood, not losing breath" It means sweating, pouring heart and soul, never stopping, never taking a break, determined to carry out our efforts to realize our ideals and goals.

tieu_de: Kien Thanh Reciting Auspicious mantra
tom_tat: This year, from Lunar New Year, we together sincerely recite the mantra Tieu Tai Cat
noi_dung:
Kien Thanh Reciting Auspicious mantra

This year, from Lunar New Year, we together sincerely recite the mantra Tieu Tai Cat Tuong:

"Nam mô.Tam mãn đa. Mẫu đà nẫm. A bát la để. Hạ đa xá. Sa nẵng nẫm. Ðát điệt tha. Án. Khư khư. Khư hê. Khư hê. Hồng hông. Nhập phạ ra. Nhập phạ ra. Bát ra nhập phạ ra. Bát ra nhập phạ ra. Ðể sắt xá. Ðể sắt xá. Sắt trí rị. Sắt chí rị. Sa phấn trá. Sa phấn trá. Phiến để ca. Thất lí duệ Sa bà ha."

If you concentrate on reciting, you will definitely have an inconceivable feeling and reach the realm as in the saying: "Induction of communication."

Why do we need to recite the mantra Tieu Tai Cat Tuong? To pray for the whole world and all humanity to recover from disasters and reach a happy place. That is the reason that motivated the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to celebrate the Dharma Assembly of Tieu Tai Au Cat Tuong. In short, it is to help sentient beings escape from the ocean of suffering, and has no other purpose.

Some temples, no matter what Dharma meeting they open, are aimed at merit donors (people who donate money to make merit). The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is not like that, there is no Dharma assembly where we aim at the main merits, we only have the main merits. What is considered master merit? That means the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas presides over the merits and dedicating merits of all merits for all humanity in this world.

Here we bring with all our heart and thoughts the mantra Tieu Tai Cat Tuong, for the benefit of all humanity, not just the benefit of the few people in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. This Dharma conference is so large and vast that it has no outside, meaning it is so big that it covers all sentient beings, with no sentient being outside. Anyone, regardless of whether they believe in Buddha or not, whether they are good or evil, we bring dedicating merit to all, helping everyone escape suffering and enjoy peace and joy.

Carrying out these Dharma conferences, we do not set a price, we only worry about fulfilling our duties, wholeheartedly with our vocation. Of course, to pray for peace and happiness is to pray for all sentient beings. If we do not understand clearly, we will lose the meaning of the Dharma assembly. Therefore, we must recite with sincerity and earnestness to be able to touch the compassion of Buddha and Bodhisattva, causing them to have mercy and help alleviate disasters for sentient beings. Big disasters turn into small disasters, and small disasters are always resolved. Here we wholeheartedly pray for all humanity to have a good end. That's what's valuable!

Thanks to the preeminent position of the Van Buddha Thanh ashram, we can eliminate disasters for all humanity in the world, which is truly an extremely ideal thing. Without that place, no place can help us achieve this merit. Therefore, in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, there is a regulation to do "pure worship," That is, clean up, on the night of the end of the lunar calendar, so that on the morning of the first day of the Lunar New Year, you can start reciting the mantra Tieu Tai Cat Tuong. The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas owns merit, meaning it presides over the making of merit to dedicating merit to sentient beings all over the world.

Gentlemen! Participating in these types of dharma conferences is an honor! A stroke of luck! Please keep your spirits up, recite with sincerity, and don't smear the surface to cover up a lazy mind. Everyone must recite together with one heart for the sake of saving sentient beings. Recite! Recite! Recite! Recite!

tieu_de: The Five Precepts and Ten Virtues Eliminate Accidents
tom_tat: Because living beings create karma, so many accidents appear in the world. There is a saying: "Initiating confusion, creating karma, receiving retribution," these three things are closely related to each other. If there is no initiation, there will be no creation of karma, and...
noi_dung:
The Five Precepts and Ten Virtues Eliminate Accidents

Because living beings create karma, so many accidents appear in the world. There is a saying: "Initiate confusion, create karma, receive retribution," These three things are closely related to each other. If there is no origin, there will be no karma, and from there there will be no retribution.

Confusion or delusion arises, due to lack of true wisdom, so there is no clarity when facing the truth, meaning the mind is crazy. To be more clear, this is the case of not knowing clearly between right and wrong, good and evil, not even black and white, not knowing right from wrong. In short, it's all due to a lack of clear judgment whose main source is the evil effects of ignorance.

Creating karma must include creating good karma and creating bad karma. Creating good karma will result in rebirth in heaven, creating bad karma will lead to hell. Because of not distinguishing clearly, the karma of stealing, the karma of adultery, the karma of lying, the karma of drinking alcohol, etc. are created. But within these karmas, there are also differences in severity.

Killing: Like the act of killing mosquitoes and ants, for example, that is called killing. Killing cows and pigs is killing living beings. But in this case, the karma retribution is not very heavy, because animals are stupid creatures, they cannot find their killer for a while, and if they do find one, they will not know how to take revenge. However, in the world, the law of cause and effect is very fair. In the confusion of life, without knowing where or what the cause is, we will see cause and effect coming, maybe we will suffer from a disability, or will be tormented by illness, which is an example of negative retribution. Like today, most people with cancer have created negative karmas related to killing in their previous or current lives, so they encounter this type of disease that has no cure.

Among the karma of killing, the karma of killing is the most serious. The murdered victim turned into an unjust ghost, immediately following him, the unjust victim did not report, and was not willing, so he would definitely wait, if there was a chance to avenge the past resentment. The murderer must be punished by the law, or he is mentally unstable, unable to stand still, always in a situation of threat, sooner or later his spirit will decline, and if he doesn't die, he will go crazy.

Theft: As a thief, my heart is often filled with fear. People often say: "Thieves are rotten," Thieves have weak liver and gallbladder. If there is no act of theft, then you will not be ashamed to look up, you will not be ashamed to bow down, what is there to be afraid of? What we do, what we create, is very noble and brilliant, so what else are we afraid of?

Adultery: Adultery is absolutely forbidden for people leaving the home life, but for Buddha lay disciples, adultery is only prohibited if it is not between husband and wife. In addition, lustful thoughts must also be precepted, it is impossible to keep from morning to night filled with disordered thoughts, all day being haunted by lustful thoughts until one's hair turns gray and one's teeth fall out! Who knows, in the next life those thoughts will still pursue, and then in the next life forever, it is true that "because of lust we are born, because of lust we die."

Lie: Liars never believe anyone's words. Because we ourselves do not speak the truth, we think that others do not speak the truth either. There is a saying: "Using the heart of a petty person, measure the heart of a gentleman." We specialize in lying to deceive others, so we assume that others tell the same lies as us.

Drink alcohol: People who drink alcohol easily lose their reason. When you're too enthusiastic, you don't have time to think about the consequences, so it's easy to create unethical and unjust actions. The reason is "drinking without virtue" Reason at that time could no longer restrain emotions.

The cause of all disasters in the world is because people do not keep the five precepts and do not know how to practice the ten virtues. During the reign of the Holy King Turning the Wheel, everyone kept the Five Precepts and practiced the Ten Virtues, so at that time in the world there was not the slightest accident, it was truly a period of "favorable wind and rain, peaceful country and people". Nowadays, everyone doesn't keep the Five Precepts and doesn't practice the Ten Virtues, that's why there are so many disasters. That's the basic thing.

tieu_de: The World Is Full of Killing Aura
tom_tat: Everyone carries an atomic warhead (defilement) within themselves, just waiting for the opportunity to explode. The power of afflictions is more formidable than the power of an atomic bullet. You guys try it! Nowadays, people in the world are very easy to…
noi_dung:
The World Is Full of Killing Aura

Everyone carries an atomic warhead (defilement) within themselves, just waiting for the opportunity to explode. The power of afflictions is more formidable than the power of an atomic bullet. You guys try it! Nowadays, people in the world are very easily angry. Regardless of whether the people of certain countries are not diligently cultivated, their minds are still full of A-tu-la thoughts. They are like experts in struggle, from morning to night just looking for ways to fight for victory. In such a situation, it causes murderous aura to rise up, filling the three thousand great thousand worlds. There is a toxic atmosphere in the air, causing strange diseases to arise in human life.

The most serious consequences of the karma of killing are natural disasters that cause harm to humanity, whether it is earthquakes, or tidal waves, or extreme cold or heat, to scenes of uneven rain, unfavorable winds, people who are not at peace, and the country is not prosperous, that is, unusual phenomena occur. As for blind, deaf, and mute people, they all created heavy karma of killing living beings in their previous lives, causing them to fall into hell after death, experience suffering, then switch to being hungry ghosts, animals, and then becoming humans. Although in the present life he is a human being, because of retribution, the six senses are not complete.

People with incomplete six faculties who do not have the opportunity to see the Buddha, hear the Dharma, or meet the Sangha, because of that obstacle, become unlucky with the Three Jewels; In short, you have to samsara within the six paths, moving up and down, unable to find the door to liberation.

Those who do good deeds can be born in the three good paths, the heavenly realm, the human realm, and the asura realm. Those who create evil karma will be born in the three evil realms (three evil paths), that is, hell, hungry ghosts, and animals. There is an ancient saying: "Exiting the blessing of the horse, entering the womb, the King of Hell returns to the past. I will obey Emperor Thich's palace and pay my respects to Diem Quan Oa." People don't have to keep their human bodies forever, sometimes they become horses, sometimes they become donkeys, they are often visitors to the King of Hell's palace, but they don't go back and forth, I don't know how many times they have passed. Just passed by the Linh Tieu palace above the palace of King De Thich (the Jade Emperor), meaning he was in heaven, but his time here was not long, now he had to visit the King of Hell, and fell into a cauldron of boiling hot oil.

No one can guarantee that they will be able to make merit and create good karma in every life. Sometimes, because of a confused mind, not making clear distinctions, and being dictated by circumstances, one commits the karma of killing, stealing, committing adultery, lying, drinking alcohol, and the five precepts.

If you do not break the five precepts and practice the ten virtues, you can be born in the heavens and enjoy heavenly blessings and pleasures. The blessings reported in heaven are ten thousand times greater than the blessings reported on earth. So after reaching heaven, no one wants to come down to earth. When the blessings reported in heaven have been enjoyed and have to return to the world, then one is a rich and noble person, not an ordinary person in society.

Being an A-tu-la is due to the cause and effect of having a strong fighting mind. They only have divine blessings but do not have divine rights and virtues. Their name means "no wine." Because they had no alcohol, they had to rob. Although they are in heaven, they do not have alcohol to drink, so they often compete with Thich Thich, with the aim of taking the throne. Asura is a type of bandit in the heavens. The bandits in the world are the reincarnations of Asura. In short, Asura is the type who loves to fight.

tieu_de: On Lunar New Year, Buddha's Teachings were preached
tom_tat: Today is the spring day, in the year of Nham Tuat of the sixty flower zodiac circle, belonging to the year of the dog. Some people are seriously injured by dog bites, while others are protected by dogs. Dogs protect good people but bite evil people. Evil people...
noi_dung:
On Lunar New Year, Buddha's Teachings were preached

Today is the spring day, in the year of Nham Tuat of the sixty flower zodiac circle, belonging to the year of the dog. Some people are seriously injured by dog bites, while others are protected by dogs. Dogs protect good people but bite evil people. Although evil people are evil, they are temporarily unharmed. What is the reason for that? Ancient people often said: "Good is rewarded with good, evil is rewarded with evil. Good and evil begin to meet their retribution, only existence and evil continue to exist." That means good will have good results, evil will have bad results; Good and evil have their consequences in the end, there are only early and late retributions, there are no mistakes. Cause and effect is a law that has not changed since ancient times.

Sowing good causes will bring good results, evil causes will bring bad results. Everything we encounter is created by ancient karma, so we must receive the results. When receiving the fruit, we should not blame heaven or resent others but should take it for granted, keep a calm mind and receive it. Destiny is not a certain thing because it is all created by ourselves. If we do a lot of good deeds, bad luck will turn into good, if we do a lot of bad things, good luck will turn into bad, so our destiny is also in our hands. Ancient people often said: "Destiny depends on oneself, happiness is sought on one's own. "The misfortune of having no subject, only the cause of self-reflection," It means that life is created by me, blessings are asked for by myself; Blessings and misfortunes have no door, they are self-inflicted. Talking about the arrangement of destiny, ordinary people have destiny, but for great people, their destiny goes beyond the framework of destiny. The same is true of great evil people, whose lives are not limited. What does that mean? For example, this individual was born unable to do evil, but that person committed a crime, so that means he has gone beyond the circle of fate. Likewise, that person was born unable to do good deeds, yet he did good deeds, which means he also went beyond the circle of fate. If you go beyond your destiny, your destiny can also change.

People who do good deeds will have good dharma-protecting gods to support them, and people who do bad deeds will also have evil gods following them, so people say: "The retribution of good and evil is like a shadow following the image." In short, doing good deeds will give you a long life, doing bad deeds will shorten your life, and your life span depends on you. If you want to improve your destiny, read "Lieu Pham Tu Huan," That book says it very clearly, so I won't say more here.

Today is the first day of the year according to the agricultural calendar. There is a sentence: "One principle restores water, all phenomena transform into new things," It means that on the first day we return and start again, everything is new, so we should start from today, innovate in our practice, definitely do it well, lest we waste time, unlike last year where we couldn't accomplish anything. This year, we are determined to be enlightened. First of all, let's make this wish. If you have the will, you will definitely get it!

Everyone cultivating the Way in this ice box needs to be very brave and diligent, otherwise they will freeze, which is not worth it. It is a waste of effort and will betray our determination at the beginning. Golden Mountain Holy Temple is a snow chest, the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is an ice warehouse. That's why most people who came to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas couldn't stand the cold and had to leave. Only a few foolish people who weren't afraid of the cold or freezing stayed in the ice warehouse to practice the Way. But there are also people who grit their teeth and try to fight the cold. They are commendable in their will and spirit of not giving in, but unfortunate in that they like to sleep and rest but do not want to practice. If you want to sleep, why don't you go to a warm place to sleep, instead of going to this ice warehouse to sleep? That's not comfortable.

Why do we have to practice so hard? It is the desire to give birth to a spiritual mind. If you stay at this ashram, you have to practice the Dharma every day, not just to have fun, to sleep every day, to waste precious time. Only in the midst of suffering do we know how to develop the mind of the path, only then can we develop the mind of Bodhi, not being greedy for enjoyment, not seeking peace. Even in a miserable situation, the mind is still at peace, not changed by the situation, but on the contrary has the ability to change the situation.

People say: "Adversity creates heroes." We are in difficult and miserable circumstances, develop the great mind of Bodhi, consider the entire world as empty, see:

Prosperous and rich in five spring soups

Fame and fame are all in vain

Eyes, bones, flesh, and feet

Love turns into hatred

Mac bai kim old flute scene

The jade seed of retirement radiates throughout the body

Purifying the mind and desire to escape the mundane world

Pleasure and duty

Translated means:

The scene of wealth and prosperity is a dream of spring

Basing your reputation is a bunch of vanity

This body has flesh and bones without legs

Love will turn into hatred

The gold shackles around the neck add more weight

Precious gems, don't worry about your body

Purify the mind and reduce the desire to escape the world

Enjoying the wind and doing your duty.

We should follow this and wake up. Even in difficult situations, we should make the effort to cultivate the Way.

On the occasion of the year of the dog, there is a verse recited as follows:

The past has passed and the new has come

Ke Ming Dog Dao begins to divide

Urgently guarding the goalkeeper's defense

Self-interest and others are single-minded.

Brief explanation is as follows: Last year has passed, now we welcome the new year. Last year was the year of the rooster, this year is the year of the dog, which is not a good time, so we must carefully guard the gateway, lest valuables be lost. This precious treasure is your true nature, also your inherent wisdom, don't let it disappear, so the six doors are the six senses that must be guarded, lest the priceless treasure be lost. To benefit oneself and benefit others is to practice the Bodhisattva path. It can only be seen by the mind, not by the outside. I hope everyone knows how to regret their time, unlike last year where the days and months just passed by, it was a waste. This year, I decided to try harder, practice meditation, and make vows for enlightenment. Wishing everyone a peaceful and happy spring season and everything going well!

tieu_de: Imitate the Spirit of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva
tom_tat: What is called Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva? This Bodhisattva is like the great earth, containing all things. All things are born from the earth and grow on the soil. Regardless of sentient or inanimate beings, they cannot leave the earth and exist...
noi_dung:
Imitate the Spirit of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

What is called Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva? This Bodhisattva is like the great earth, containing all things. All things are born from the earth and grow on the soil. Regardless of sentient or inanimate beings, they cannot leave the earth to exist. From this, it can be deduced that we humans, every time we breathe out, breathe in, move, move, speak, act, every hour, every moment, are living on the dharma body of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, we just don't know it.

Like an ant crawling on a boat, it doesn't know the boat. The boat floats on the sea, visiting everywhere, but the ant doesn't even know what a boat is? Where does the boat go? Absolutely no idea. Why is that? Because the boat is too big, the ants are too small. We exist on the dharma body of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva with the same meaning.

We live on Earth, not dependent on any place in space. The earth is maintained by the wind wheel, according to natural laws, and operates endlessly in orbit. In the void, the earth drifts and rotates, and where does it finally go? The understanding of Astronomers is nothing more than a noun, in the end they don't know what it is.

No one truly understands the mysteries of heaven and earth. Only the saints who have attained enlightenment can truly know the secret of the cosmic disaster. We as ordinary people cannot fully understand it, its meaning is inconceivable. We are all messy eaters and drinkers.

We are born, from youth to adulthood, from youth to old age, from old age to death, that is the path that everyone goes through, no one can escape this law. In such a life, some people encounter a lot of suffering - heavy karma - they experience the ultimate suffering, then realize that their body and mind and life are illusory, giving rise to pessimistic thoughts and considering life no longer interesting. Some people come from a wealthy family - karma is light - everything they wear and where they live are of the upper class, their life is full and they are satisfied. As people often say: "If you want wind, you will have wind, if you want rain, you will have rain," Even if they want the moon, parents will still try to find a way to bring the moon down to their children. Such a life, looking at it, seems very happy and very satisfying. In fact, it's not like that, it's just a life of confusion where nothing is clear, it can be said to be "drunk and dreamy." live passionately and die passionately. Without true understanding, for example, why did we come to this world? Come for what? Come to eat and drink? To wear clothes? Or come to deceive people? Come to enjoy? Those are the things that the world is confused about, no one can break that delusion.

Not only are some people unable to break through this enchantment, but those leaving the home life are also trapped in the enchantment. You can't let go of fame, you can't let go of profit, you run after fate everywhere, you get entangled everywhere, it's truly pitiful. People leaving the home life should have the thought, why do we leave the home life? Because I disregarded everything in this world and did not accept worldly dharmas, that's why I left the home life to practice religion to solve the problem of birth and death.

People leaving the home life must be earnest about the issue of birth and death, develop Bodhi mind, and not be confused and wait for death, as people say: "One day as a monk, one day as a bell ringer." With that mentality of leaving the home life, the issue of life and death is not really graspable at all.

We enter Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's spirit of saving sentient beings. In the past, Bodhisattvas once made eighteen great vows, wishing that all sentient beings escape the ocean of suffering and reach the shore of peace. He said: "Hell is not empty yet, may I not become a Buddha" and "Saving all sentient beings, only then will one attain Bodhi." He said again: "If I don't go to hell, who will go to hell?" What great prayers! You should imitate the Bodhisattva's dharma and learn the spirit of saving others and forgetting yourself. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is still in hell, suffering to preach the Dharma to sentient beings.

We are both in the dharma body of Ksitigarbha, and we are the same people leaving the home life, and together with Him, we are comrades and fellow believers in helping sentient beings. "Put yourself in a place of boiling water and fire, save sentient beings to the cool shore" is the duty of the person leaving the home life. It's not a waste of time to leave the home life, I hope everyone tries their best!

A person leaving the home life cannot have a greedy mind, they must eliminate this mind, otherwise they will not be qualified to be a person leaving the home life. If you are still greedy for this, greedy for that, greedy for everything, the more the better, even hoarding all kinds of trash, then that is truly pitiful to the extreme!

When reciting the name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, we must recite it clearly, so that the Bodhisattva can clearly understand our thoughts. Why do we recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva? Our goal is to make the Bodhisattva, after hearing the sound of our chanting, clearly know our wishes and develop a compassionate mind, so that our mind can be satisfied.

This year is the first year of the "Nine Stars Inter-Continent" period. symbolizes danger. We don't need to know whether there is danger or not, we just know that we must wholeheartedly recite "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva," I pray that the world's great disasters will turn into small disasters, and if they are small disasters, they will turn into destruction. Therefore, we only earnestly pray for peace and happiness for all humanity in the world, which is the purpose of our entering the Ksitigarbha.

This is the generous, immeasurable mind that everyone leaving the home life must keep in their hearts, considering living beings as their relatives, like the saying: "If you drown, I'll drown. If you're hungry, I'll starve," You must develop the Bodhisattva mind, self-benefit and benefit others, self-enlighten and enlighten others, and self-help others. Therefore, during the time of entering the Dharma chamber of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, the more sincere we are, the better it will be. We use all our sincerity to recite "Namo Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva."

With our mouths we very sincerely recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, then the wheel of the six paths of samsara stops spinning. I don't know how many sentient beings thanks to this opportunity can escape from samsara and escape from suffering. It can be said that reciting the name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is a miraculous work, an inconceivable merit, so we should not recite it in scheming, in bidding, not to repay the gratitude of sentient beings, in short we should recite it out of volunteerism. Because of these reasons, our ashram suddenly celebrated Ksitigarbha, without any warning or announcement. Among those residing in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, there are also people who do not know. That is because of the opportunity, the right opportunity to celebrate Ksitigarbha.

At the end of Seven Ksitigarbha, the next one is Avalokitesvara (February 19 of the lunar calendar). To pray for world peace, please everyone try to recite "Namo Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva."

There is a saying, "We will become successful," That means contributing the will - of the majority - will create a stronghold, everyone recites with the same heart, tries their best to recite, with the utmost sincerity in their thoughts, which means there is an induction, as in the saying "touching the path of communication" so. To celebrate Ksitigarbha or Avalokiteshvara, we just need to have no personal feelings, no self-interest, no fighting, no greed, no seeking, but really only for the happiness of sentient beings in the world.

At the Temple of Ten Thousand Buddhas of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, from March 7 to 12, 1982

tieu_de: Don't Pollute the Void
tom_tat: We are one with the void, no matter what delusions we have, we will naturally emit thoughts of the same kind, filling the void. The void has been polluted, we absorb polluted air into ourselves, and are born...
noi_dung:
Don't Pollute the Void

We are one with the void, no matter what delusions we have, we will naturally emit thoughts of the same kind, filling the void. The void has been polluted, we absorb polluted air into ourselves, causing illness. If it's light, the body won't feel fresh, if it's heavy, it's rancid!

Our false thoughts about wrong knowledge and wrong views, such as the minds of killing, stealing, adultery, lying, anger, jealousy, all kinds of mental obstacles, all contain toxins inside, so when they come out, they pollute the space. Because space contains many toxins, if we absorb them into the body, the body will be poisoned, the cells will mutate, and if the victim does not have cancer, it will still be a serious disease that cannot be overcome. For that reason, we must make sure that our thoughts and actions are always pure and clear, lest heaven and earth become contaminated with more poison. If the universe is filled with toxic gas, sentient beings all over the world will be poisoned and die.

Our delusions are of an unwholesome nature, and the poisonous gas in the void will increase a little; If our false thoughts are good, the good taste in emptiness will also increase. If toxic gas filled the void, it would be ten thousand times more devastating than atomic bombs.

In our midst, there are also atomic bullets, hydrogen bullets, and nuclear bullets. If there is no this or that in the mind, then there is no this or that phenomenon in the world. That means, if there is something inside, it will also appear on the outside. If there is nothing inside, there will be no manifestation on the outside, as the saying goes: "All dharmas are created by the mind."

There is an ancient saying: "The world is all right, let people trouble themselves." It means that there is nothing wrong with the world itself, what is happening is caused by people causing trouble. This is a reference to foolish people who realize that this is real, that is real, this and that are real, and then death is also real, but they themselves do not understand how to die, so pitiful!

Foolish people, living in the world, are crazy, troubled, arguing, and never stop. Outside there is nothing, inside there is; In nothingness, in sleep there is. What is there? There are delusions. Delusional thoughts are confused, the mind is not pure. We must remember that false thoughts are the stones that tie the feet of practitioners, making it difficult for us to achieve karma.

You guys watch! That person is truly a monster, but he himself does not realize that he is a monster, and still considers this body as precious and must be loved and protected, thinking about it all the time. Must take vitamin pills! Live a few more years! Anyone, priests, pastors, monks, most people must take vitamin pills every day, considering it a source of vitality, a source of health, a way to maintain life and immortality.

Now I tell you! Reduce your delusions, that is more useful than any tonic. Not believing that truth is truly delusional. That is the true morality, you cannot not believe it, if you do not believe it means you do not have wisdom. People without wisdom do not know how to believe in the truth.

What is truth? Truth is correct morality. For example, if a person has a lot of desires, no amount of supplements will be effective. The reason is in the nature of the word "contraband," gonorrhea means to seep out, escape.

That person does not clearly understand the meaning of true birth cultivation: purify the mind and fruit of desire, keep the mind pure, and have few desires. We as practitioners, first of all, abandon love and eliminate desire, a basic rule, otherwise, even if we practice for eighty thousand eons, we will not achieve anything.

I came from San Francisco to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas to preach the sutras. Of course I have to tell the truth, to make you understand the true nature of cultivating the Way. If I don't tell you the truth, it's cold like this, everyone sitting in the lecture hall will be penetrated by the cold wind. If you don't reach the truth, then there's no point in enduring the cold, there's no saving it.

What I said today is the truth. I hope that after listening, you will take care of your own three poisons of greed, anger, and ignorance, and do not release poisonous gas into space, in order to help all sentient beings breathe some fresh air. Your merit is truly immeasurable, just like indirectly liberating living beings. I further hope that we all try to destroy delusion. If you don't have false thoughts, you will be completely free and very precious. So, even if you endure the cold, your efforts will not be in vain.

Winter at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is to test the concentration of practitioners, to train their bodies and minds. In the summer, the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is also a testing field.

Everything is a test,

Let's see how I am,

For situations like not knowing,

Must practice again from the beginning.

You must remember these sentences.

A few days from now we will organize a Buddha-vent and a meditation-room (one Buddha-house, three meditation-rooms, the term is 28 days). According to the meaning of the saying "Eastern meditation, Lower learning," In winter, when the climate is cold, people should practice meditation. During hot summer days, it is better to listen to sutras and sermons. Why? If you practice meditation in a hot atmosphere, sitting like that will make you sweat, your mind will become depressed and you won't be able to sit for a long time. It's winter, it's cold, sitting down is like holding a block of ice in your arms and having to grit your teeth to endure. At that time, there will be a stream of warm air rising from inside you, dispelling the cold air and preventing it from penetrating your body, and thus you will be able to sit with peace of mind and easily have the opportunity to enter concentration. If one cannot activate the flow of warmth in the body, the practitioner will feel cold penetrating. Oh my! It's so cold! Deadly cold! You don't make any effort, naturally you feel cold; If you work hard, you won't feel cold.

Now there is this koan, mentioned for reference. Previously, there was a wise man who led a group of disciples out on a journey to consult the religion. All of them are people from the South, but now when they go to the North, they encounter cold winters, with ice and snow causing all kinds of insects to freeze to death. The group of disciples couldn't stand the cold so they lit a fire to warm up. The wise man saw this and scolded him: "If a cultivator cannot endure hunger and cold, then how can he practice?" After saying that, he planned to use water to extinguish the fire and at the same time taught: "You don't know how to start the furnace inside yourself, but instead you run out to find fire to keep warm. You really have no spirit, no determination!" When the disciples saw their master's anger, they all remained silent, not daring to say a word. They extinguished the fire. Seeing the fire inside them ignite, they immediately sat down on the ground to meditate and no longer felt cold. From there, we can see that we cannot rely on external conditions, but must know how to be self-reliant and use our own strength to overcome all unsatisfactory circumstances.

tieu_de: Dao and Preciousness are in Action
tom_tat: To study Buddha Dharma, the more you study, the more intelligent you must be to have the opportunity to become enlightened. The more you study, the more foolish you become. You study for a long time but your wisdom does not increase, and you become even more confused, not understanding the right dharma from the wrong dharma....
noi_dung:
Dao and Preciousness are in Action

To study Buddha Dharma, the more you study, the more intelligent you must be to have the opportunity to become enlightened. The more you study, the more foolish you become. You study for a long time but your wisdom does not increase, and you become even more confused, not understanding the right dharma from the wrong dharma. Why is that situation? The reason is because of not researching to the end. After listening to Buddha's Dharma, we must practice it practically, following the teachings and practicing the Dharma. It's not like after listening to the sutras, you take the sutras and put them on the bookshelf, and then don't mention the sutras anymore. After hearing the teachings, you should earnestly ask yourself whether you can follow that teachings or not. Learning Buddha's teachings like this will not be a waste of effort and will not waste precious time.

The ancients said: "Words are Dharma, actions are Dharma." Also said: "Speak well, speak well, without practice, it is not the way," There is another sentence: "The way is practice, without practice, the way is of no use; Virtue is established, virtue is not established." In cold weather like this, coming to preach the Buddha Dharma, to listen to the Buddha Dharma, so we must practice it practically, to know how to listen to the Dharma. Otherwise, no matter how many sutras and dharmas you hear, they will all be useless. Regarding this point, I hope you understand deeply.

Cultivate the Way! Cultivate the Way! Cultivate the Way! Must practice religion! What is religious practice? Eating rice is cultivating the path, wearing clothes is cultivating the path, sleeping is cultivating the path. When we eat, we must eat it all, not just eat half a bowl of rice and throw the other half into the trash, thus consuming all the blessings. When wearing clothes, they must be clean and cannot be worn dirty, otherwise they will lose their majesty. When sleeping, you must also keep it clean, bedding and pillows must be neat and clean, not sloppy, so that outsiders will lose all elegance when looking at them. Furthermore, for people leaving the home life, the four great postures of walking, standing, lying down, and sitting must be emphasized even more.

While the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is still new, there must be rules everywhere, everything must be done well. First, let's start from a small place, each person cleans up his or her room, a piece of paper, a pen, must also be placed in their place; Not even a needle or a thread should be thrown away indiscriminately. We must nurture good habits, so that one day we can go out for consultations, or take refuge (Quai Don) at an ashram that still maintains a neat, error-free manner, to avoid the case of "Thien Dan". (have to go somewhere else). Please pay special attention to this point.

tieu_de: Keep Your Mouth In Mind
tom_tat: There is an ancient saying: "There are two paths of good and evil: practice for the purpose of practice, creation for the purpose of creation" (good and evil are two paths, the path of practice and the path of creation). This is completely correct. Practice what? Cultivate the path of goodness. Create what? Create evil karma. Compassionate…
noi_dung:
Keep Your Mouth In Mind

There is an ancient saying: "Good and evil are two ways, cultivate for the sake of cultivating, create for the sake of creating" (There are two paths of good and evil, the path of practice and the path of creation). This is completely correct. Practice what? Cultivate the path of goodness. Create what? Create evil karma. Good knowledge warns us and never gets tired of it, but we are stupid and do not know how to receive the right teachings. Whatever we do, we only know to benefit ourselves without thinking about the benefits of others and, in other words, we only know how to create evil karma and do not practice goodness, so we cannot get out of the six realms of samsara.

Our thoughts are immeasurable, boundless, endless. If you recite it, you will run to heaven, if you recite it, you will go to hell. False thoughts of good belong to the realm of heaven, false thoughts of evil belong to hell. Therefore, with every move, every word, every action, we must always be careful, every hour, every moment, we must pay attention everywhere, the inside and outside are the same.

On the outside, the actions are very good, but on the inside, they are full of delusions, which also do not bring results. We have to make sure that the inside and outside are the same, not following false thoughts. There are people whose minds are full of false thoughts, thinking that no one outside knows, and then keep thinking like that every day, until they go to hell and bring it with them, but they themselves don't know why they fell into hell. Such people are pitiful!

We are practitioners, we must keep our mouths shut when living together. When the masses live in the same place, they must be careful of gossip. There is a very wise saying: "Disasters are exported, diseases are imported." That means disaster is caused by words that come out of the mouth, and disease is also brought in from the mouth. We shouldn't say anything, try to avoid trouble, it's best to keep your mouth shut. There is another sentence: "Just because the concubine opens her mouth, her troubles are forced to come out." Sitting alone protects the mind, which means that when sitting alone we must carefully guard our minds and not follow false thoughts, especially thoughts of lust. People leaving the home life must pay special attention and carefully manage their minds, not allowing useless thoughts to disturb them.

Everyone has false thoughts, but when false thoughts start, we must apply methods to control them and not let false thoughts cause trouble. Those methods are either we recite the Buddha's name, or we recite mantras, or we meditate, pray, in short, find something else to do, so that our spirit is focused so there will be no delusions.

People who practice religion must first break down the door of lust. If you cannot break it, there is no hope of successful practice. All day long, my mind is confused and my mind is crazy, but I still don't succeed. So I sincerely tell you that we must subdue this mind. Subduing the mind means ending lustful thoughts. If we cannot get rid of it, then even if we practice for eighty thousand great kalpas, it will be no different from boiling sand to have food to eat. This has never happened before.

Do you want to practice and attain the fruit of sainthood without outflows? If you cut off desire and love, and purify your mind and fruit of desire, then there is still some hope. If not, there is no hope. It is better to quickly return to the world to avoid wasting time!

Regardless of whether you are male or female, or whether you are a Bhikkhu, Bhikkhunī, Upasaka, Upasāṇa, old or young, we will listen to anyone who speaks righteous principles, and if we do not believe them, we must not believe them. We must have the eye to choose the Dharma. If it is ethical then move forward, if it is not ethical then retreat; Choose what is good to follow, change what is bad, that is the very basic viewpoint of a practitioner.

Some people know clearly their mistakes but don't change them, know but still do wrong. These types of people are very difficult to educate, they cannot afford Buddha's teachings, and cannot learn anything more. People say: "Rotten wood is difficult to carve, walls made of dung are difficult to plaster," If you don't help yourself and look down on yourself, who will still value you and help you? That is something you need to consider carefully.

tieu_de: Maggots On Body
tom_tat: Avatamsaka Sutra says: On the countless sambhogakayas of all Buddhas appear countless pores. At each pore, the realms of all Buddhas appear, including the huge precious lotus flower and countless lotus leaves. Each leaf is generous…
noi_dung:
Maggots On Body

Avatamsaka Sutra says: On the countless sambhogakayas of all Buddhas appear countless pores. At each pore, the realms of all Buddhas appear, including the huge precious lotus flower and countless lotus leaves. Each leaf radiates light, each ray of light radiates more light, appearing in countless forms, endlessly. In the halo appears the moon, within the moon there is the moon. Those types of realms are manifested by all Buddhas.

There is also an appearance on our bodies. What appears? Insects appear. There are countless insects in our bodies, and these insects are more stinky than the maggots in the toilet. On these insects there are also countless bacteria, which our naked eyes cannot see, except for those who have attained celestial vision can see them (currently advanced microscopes cannot see these types). Bacteria are extremely dirty, we just don't know it. Look at this big insect (the human body), how much people cherish it, how important it is, but are afraid of it being hungry and thirsty, afraid of it being cold or hot, thinking of every way to protect it! Why do you love it so much? The reason is because of the three poisons. Having a greedy mind will give birth to greedy insects. Having an angry mind gives birth to an angry insect. If you have a foolish mind, there will be stupid worms. In short, if you have any thoughts, there will be worms of the same type.

Our thoughts are much dirtier than the maggots in the toilet, they contain all kinds of wrong knowledge and wrong views, without any right knowledge or right view. The dirtier your thoughts are, the more you think about dirty things, even creating a dirty world full of pollution, so it turns into the five impurities (the evil world has five impurities).

The five evil defilements are caused by our impure thoughts. This Saha world was originally impure, it is because of us that it has become impure. The five impurities include the impurity of life, the impurity of views, the impurity of afflictions, the impurity of sentient beings, the impurity of life, and the five impure things. How terrifying!

In our minds, there are thoughts that are not right, roughly like thoughts of jealousy, for example, and thoughts of obstacles, which often arise without us admitting it, but we keep it hidden inside, thinking that no one knows. In fact, that behavior is even worse than that of demons and demons. To put it bluntly, it is so evil that it can be compared to the action of emitting filthy gas and foul smells that reached the thirty-third heavens, causing the Jade Emperor to cover his nose and run. Think about it! Is that foul smell harmful or not harmful? The stench was unbearable.

My thoughts and actions are just as stinky, but I don't know it, I consider myself noble, little do I know that I have polluted this world. Because of that, there are five evil defilements.

You should know, if we have a righteous thought, we have helped the right energy of heaven and earth; One evil thought means a foul smell is emitted, the air rushes up, heaven and earth cannot bear it. This is not a joke, a joke, that's exactly what it is.

Why does heaven cause drought without rain? Because people release foul air, rushing up into the void, causing the dragon that specializes in making rain to not be able to stand the smell of unclean air, it has to run away, thus not being able to complete its mission.

tieu_de: Thai Thuong Lao Quan Thanh Tinh Kinh
tom_tat: We study Buddha Dharma to practice the Way, to practice the Way is to become Buddha; If you want to become a Buddha, you must study Buddha's teachings; To study Buddha's teachings, one must practice the way. Only by practicing can one become a Buddha. This is an immutable principle. During the period of religious practice,...
noi_dung:
Thai Thuong Lao Quan Thanh Tinh Kinh

We study Buddha Dharma to practice the Way, to practice the Way is to become Buddha; If you want to become a Buddha, you must study Buddha's teachings; To study Buddha's teachings, one must practice the way. Only by practicing can one become a Buddha. This is an immutable principle. During the period of religious practice, all actions and creations go beyond the scope of worldly thoughts and actions. People in this world are still attached to family activities, still craving pleasure and enjoyment. People leaving the home life live the exact opposite, giving up pleasure, giving up happiness, giving up enjoyment. People say: "If you let go, you will never die, and you will never be born again; Let go of the false impermanence and become the true immortality." That is: If you cannot let go of death, you cannot change life; If you can't let go of the false, you can't become the real thing. Let go of the fake, then pick up the leg. To study Buddha Dharma, you must practice the Dharma. What actually is religion? The Tao has no form at all, so Lao Tzu said:

The invisible great path, giving birth to heaven and earth. The great path has no emotions, operating on the sun and moon. The nameless great path nourishes all things. Wu does not know the name, forcing the name is the way. Those who follow the Buddha's teachings are clear, there is turbulence, there is movement, there is stillness, the sky is clear and the earth is turbid, the sky is moving and the earth is still. Young men and women are corrupt, men are dynamic and women are still, the birth of the original flows to the end, and the children give birth to all things.

Above is a sutra text in Lao Tzu's Thanh Tinh Sutra. Lao Tzu analyzes the meaning of "dao" clearly, can be used for reference.

Legend in Buddhism records that Lao Tzu is the reincarnation of the Venerable Maha Kassapa, because the Venerable loves old age, even though he is old, he is not old. When he is old, he still diligently practices the Dau-da practice, often eats things that other people cannot eat, wears clothes that other people do not want to wear, resides in places where other people cannot stay, these are just a few of the Venerable's twelve ascetic practices that later generations often take as a standard.

According to legend, Lao Tzu was in his mother's womb for eighty-one years before being born. Why is that? Because in a previous life, Lao Tzu had studied the I Ching, so he had some understanding, and regarding Ba-tu about the time of birth, he researched carefully to choose the best time to be born, based on the combination of year, month, day, and hour (these four time elements are calculated according to both liver and chi, so it is called Ba-tu [eight words]), at that time he was born. However, if you encounter a good year, the month will be bad, if you encounter a good month, the day will not be good, etc. Just like that, he waited for eighty-one years without finding an auspicious moment. When he was born, his hair was gray, his beard was gray, but his spirit was young, truly "a crane with a bright face". (white hair like a crane, young appearance), doesn't look like a crooked old man. Therefore, people called him Lao Tzu.

Lao Tzu was born in the Eastern Chau period, at the same time as Confucius. History records that: "Confucius asked Lao Dam (Lao Tzu) about the ceremony. When he returned, he exclaimed that (that person) was like a dragon." During the Chau dynasty, Lao Tzu held the position of Thu-tang-lai (library keeper). Later, he rode a green buffalo. When passing through the gate of Ham Coc mandarin, he was recognized by mandarin Lenh Doan Hy. This man came to pray and learned the Dharma. Lao Tzu spoke two sections of the Tao Te Sutra, the upper section talks about morality, the lower section talks about virtue, a total of more than five thousand words. After that, no one knows his whereabouts anymore.

Lao Tzu studied astronomy, studied geography, and also studied the humanities, so he wrote a series of scriptures called the Thanh Tinh Kinh. Sutra text is as follows:

The invisible great path, giving birth to heaven and earth: The universe is so vast, but it was born from Tao. If there is no religion, then heaven and earth, moon and stars, etc. There is nothing, everything is just a chaos. Because there is religion, there is heaven, earth, all things, then there are fairies, Buddhas, saints.

After all, what is religion? The Tao has no form, but has the effect of "birth and birth, endless transformation." The Tao is also O

(circle), then we can be born in heaven, on earth, in all living things, in immortals, Buddhas, saints. That all comes from the properties of O.

The great path is indifferent, operating on the sun and moon: The great path has no emotions, and is equal in the face of all things; Unlike humans, they act in emotions, have lovers, and have love. People leaving the home life also have love - you see! Cultivating the path must be free from emotions, must be ruthless, even the slightest emotion should be abandoned, that is, "sweep away all emotions, cut off all desires." Someone said: "Is that like inhuman plants?" That's not true. That is a phenomenon that transcends worldly dharma.

The sun is the quintessence of the positive element, the moon is the quintessence of the yin element, both operate continuously in orbit, that's why there are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, winter, more specifically divided into twenty-four periods, seventy-two seasons. Weather and weather both arise from the operation of the moon and sun.

The nameless great path nourishes all things: The great path has no name, but all things are born and grow from within the great path. This realm, the more we study it, the more magical it becomes.

When I was sixteen years old, I wrote the following verse: "All things are born humanely, one attains self-intelligence, fully comprehends the truth, Bodhi does not decrease or increase," The idea goes like this: All things are born from religion. Whoever wants it will have wisdom, will understand everything without hindrance, and everything will be clear. There are three bodies, four minds, five eyes, and six powers. Why was Buddha like that? Because Buddha attained enlightenment, was enlightened, and attained Buddhahood. Why can't we be like that? Because we are firmly bound by habit, making it impossible for us to reform and innovate, so we do not know how to distinguish clearly. If you have wisdom, you will naturally have a clear understanding of the wonderful principles, knowing that enlightenment is neither increasing nor decreasing, because at this point you have achieved the state of no education.

Wu does not know the name, forcing the name is the way: Old Tzu said: "I don't know what its name is, so I reluctantly gave it a name, called 'Dao' that's it!" Next, Lao Tzu explains as follows:

Fake Taoist! there is sound and there is impurity, there is movement and there is stillness: This Tao has sound and impurity. Pure to the extreme becomes impure, impure to the extreme then becomes pure. This Tao, its nature is natural, like electric vapor, it has movement and stillness, movement is positive and static is negative, so there is a saying: "The Way of One Yang and One Yin" One yang with one yin is the Tao.

The sky is clear and the earth is turbulent, the sky is moving and the earth is still: The sky is clear, the clear air rises to form the sky; The soil is turbid, the turbid air sinks to become soil. The sky is moving, the moon and sun are moving, the stars are moving, everything is moving. The land is still, the mountains, rivers, large land, and houses are all in a static state.

Men are young and women are volatile, men are dynamic and women are still: Men belong to the pure body, women belong to the impure body. Men are active, tend to go abroad, build a career, and travel everywhere. Women are calm and stay inside, helping their husbands teach their children and manage the family. Husband and wife divide their duties and cooperate, creating a good family. Nowadays, men and women have equal rights, economic equality, and even go to the point of homosexuality, which is against the yin and yang law of heaven and earth, creating disasters and inevitably falling into hell.

The birth of the origin saves the end and birth of all things: From the root to the tip, entering the six paths of samsara, being born as a human or not, those are all kinds of sentient animals, then hundreds of thousands of strange things, everything is there. Talking about humans, for example, we see so many different races, different skin colors, different looks and height, different temperaments, in short, there are many different physical appearances. Other animals, as you can guess, also have many differences. All things are general, including both sentient and inanimate beings. Sentient beings are animals, inanimate beings are plants and minerals.

Please think carefully, if we don't practice religion properly then why don't we leave the home life. Living loosely, we can still eat, drink, have fun, at will, without constraints or obstacles. When you leave the home life and refuse to practice, what is the purpose of leaving the home life like that? Isn't that so stupid? To be honest, it's really pitiful! Leaving the home life is only a practice that will not be in vain, not a waste of time, and will not disappoint the wishes at the beginning. Understand your purpose of leaving the home life, which is enlightenment, becoming Buddha. If you step back halfway and your mind regresses, then above you will be at fault with all the Buddhas, parents, and teachers who have expected you, and below you will be at fault with the sentient beings who have entrusted you. Living beings are hoping that we will save them from the ocean of suffering, but in the case just mentioned, we have completely disappointed them!

tieu_de: The Ashram of Eternal Dharma
tom_tat: The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the teaching place of the Dharma in the world, the source of world Buddhism and also the place where world Buddhism returns to its source. If the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas has a foundation, then the demons of pagans must be surprised...
noi_dung:
The Ashram of Eternal Dharma

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the teaching place of the Dharma in the world, the source of world Buddhism and also the place where world Buddhism returns to its source. If the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas has a basis, then the demons of pagans will be shocked and scared, to the point of making their hair stand on end. The left sect will also be tense, they tremble in fear, cannot sleep well, cannot eat and taste, so they must think of every plan, find every way to sabotage, to destroy the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, so that the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas fails, goes to the point of destruction, cannot exist. They think like that is no different than a fool talking in a dream, something that cannot be done.

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is an ashram protected by all Buddhas of the ten directions. That is "rising from the ground, appearing as Bao Vuong Tower," Therefore, the Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is as solid as diamond, no one can destroy it, no one can destroy it. In other words, the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is a "light station" - lantern - shines pure light into the dark places in the minds of sentient beings, leading sentient beings on the path of enlightenment to Bodhi.

Anyone who resides in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas has great good roots and great virtue. Otherwise, they wouldn't have come here. Those virtuous people who come to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas are like entering a precious mountain, reaping priceless treasures - enlightenment and enlightenment. People without virtue, coming here is like sitting on a carpet of nails, not feeling at peace.

On this earth, the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the starting place for propagating the Dharma, so for those residing here, every action, every movement, every word must comply with the rules established by Buddha. Only in the eyes of the demons and demons do they see differently and consider it wrong. The Holy City of Ten Thousand Buddhas has the custom of eating one meal a day (daily food), not sleeping at night, not lying down on the bed at night (rape not before passing away), wearing robes regularly (ca-sa not separating), men and women do not talk (support does not lecture). Outsiders consider this to be out of date and out of trend, why? Because the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas promotes the Dharma and people like to live in the age of the end of Dharma, living freely and not wanting to be restricted. Therefore, no matter what the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas does or what action they take, it is considered wrong, and they must do their best to attack, sabotage and destroy it.

There are many people who come to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas and feel that they are not at peace. That's because they still have many mixed worldly habits, so when they arrive, they immediately encounter obstacles, making their minds not happy with the regulations of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. They see you leaving the home life as a monk and think that this is against nature. They don't understand that: "If you endure suffering, suffering will end, if you enjoy blessings, blessings will end." This is a precious teaching. Just because we want to enjoy temporary happiness, we sow karma for the next life.

The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas does not follow evil practices, nor do the people of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, they all develop Bodhi minds and strive to practice the Way. So here, when there is a Ksitigarbha room, or Avalokitesvara room, or Buddha room or Zen room, no matter the time, everyone tries to endure hardship, never resting. Wanting to leave the home life to practice religion, not wanting to suffer, wanting to be happy, wanting to enjoy, wanting to become enlightened, wanting to become Buddha, there really is no such morality.

In this world, there is never a situation where you can eat without working. Thinking that taking advantage of comfort for yourself is just an illusion of a fool. The ancients said: "Part plowing is part harvest," A very reasonable sentence. All living in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas clearly understand this principle, so everyone tries, everyone seriously practices, works hard and works, and develops the mind of Bodhi. Every day from morning to night, be diligent, no more time for delusion. The important thing is not to follow fate, not to get involved with anyone. Whoever comes to the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas should clearly realize that.

Pagans cannot destroy a single tree or blade of grass in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Why? Because evil cannot overcome righteousness. The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas is the place where the Dharma abides in the world, the place where all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas protect, so before and after the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas still wins, every storm passes and still exists. Anyone who has other thoughts is just wasting their efforts.

tieu_de: The Realm of the Dharma Era
tom_tat: During the time of the Dharma, the saints appeared in the world to support Buddha in propagating the Dharma. At that time, the disciples who had left the home life with Buddha for countless lifetimes all followed Buddha to practice. The saints have witnessed that result...
noi_dung:
The Realm of the Dharma Era

During the time of the Dharma, the saints appeared in the world to support Buddha in propagating the Dharma. At that time, the disciples who had left the home life with Buddha for countless lifetimes all followed Buddha to practice. The saints who have attained that fruit all make vows: Follow Buddha everywhere to turn the wheel of Dharma and save sentient beings. There is a saying: "One Buddha propagates, a thousand Buddhas protect." After the Buddha entered Nirvana, those saints also took turns entering the Pure Land of Constant Light.

Five hundred years after the Buddha passed away, the cultivator's base was no longer as sharp as before, and the good base was not thick enough, so it turned into the time of dharma images - that is, worshiping the Buddha's statue only. That was the period when people built pagodas, created stupas, and cast Buddha statues, but forgot about building wisdom life and Dharma body, so every day practitioners moved further and further away from the Dharma period and turned to Dharma statues.

The age of symbolic dharma lasted for a thousand years, but now it has passed and we are in the age of the end of dharma. During the Dharma era, people still practice according to the Dharma, no one defames or attacks the Dharma, people behave in peace, without controversy. Not in the way of "the Sangha destroys the Sangha, Buddha's Dharma is destroyed" that "the increase spreads, the Buddha Dharma flourishes." During the Dharma period, there is no praise, but there is also no defamation. At the time of the Dharma, there is praise and no defamation, but when the Dharma ends, there is only defamation and no praise.

During the end of the dharma, everyone said that Buddhism was superstitious and specialized in worshiping images. Even Buddhist followers followed everyone, saying whatever they wanted, not understanding anything clearly, not clarifying the truth. That is what proves that Buddhism has reached its end, when no one can understand Buddha's teachings anymore.

Because everyone does not understand Buddha's teachings, there are some people who specialize in nitpicking and criticizing Buddhism for bad things, and they do not know about good things, causing the truth in Buddhism to be destroyed. The lay person does not understand the truth, even the person leaving the home life is not clear, they are all confused, everyone says whatever they say and the blind lead the blind.

The following verse is extremely good, I would like to mention it here for our reference:

May the three hindrances and afflictions be eliminated,

Pray to attain true wisdom

Universal vows that all sins and obstacles will be eliminated

In this world, we often practice the Bodhisattva path.

Let me briefly explain as follows:

Wishing to eliminate the three hindrances and afflictions: The three hindrances are karma hindrance, retribution hindrance, affliction hindrance. We must eliminate these three hindrances completely, not just saying it through our mouths: Must eliminate! Must eliminate! But actually I don't want to eliminate it. In short, hiding one's shortcomings, nurturing those shortcomings, not daring to bring them to light properly, in the end, the karma hindrance becomes deeper and deeper each day, each day more and more severe, and the afflictions and afflictions increase day by day.

Wishing to attain true wisdom: If the three hindrances are not completely eliminated, there cannot be true wisdom. If you have true wisdom, you will never do crazy things. Using wisdom and not ignorance to handle everything is then called true clarity, but knowing one thing but understanding only half of it is not true clarity.

Universal vows that all evil obstacles are eliminated: I vow to eliminate the three hindrances, not only for myself but also for all sentient beings. That is my original vow, and I often use it as my vow to act.

In this world, we often practice the Bodhisattva path: Although I am not a Bodhisattva, I vow to do what Bodhisattvas often do in the Bodhisattva path. I study Bodhisattva so I practice this method. Bodhisattvas do not practice in one day, but practice one day at a time. Buddha Shakyamuni Buddha, He cultivated blessings of wisdom for three monk periods, cultivated good form for hundreds of kalpas, and after three great kalpas of ashanga kalpas, for such a long time, His merits were only perfect, blessings of wisdom were complete, meaning "the triangle is perfect, ten thousand virtues are covered," He has just become the Supreme Being.

After making vows, you must comply immediately. There can be no self-interest, self-interest, argumentative mind, greedy mind, scheming mind, or lying mind. Without these six types of mind, you will have the Dharma, changing the ending Dharma into the Dharma. If it's the opposite, then it's the end of the dharma, turning the true dharma into the end of the dharma. If we use the above six principles to handle everything, we will immediately have justice, impartiality, and great clarity in everything. Cultivating the Way will definitely lead to success. All Buddhas in all ten directions constantly support us. Please pay attention! It is this dharma, there is no other dharma. You should follow it and work hard, it won't be wrong.

We must know how to endure suffering and endure hardship. Don't be greedy for convenience, don't be cunning and deceitful, but move forward honestly. Remember this well! Don't be greedy for good food, don't be greedy for wearing expensive clothes, don't be greedy for a beautiful house, don't be greedy for everything, and don't be greedy for enjoyment. If so, then the Dharma will abide in the world.

In the Dharma era, everyone practices. At the end of the Dharma, no one practiced. If everyone is willing to practice, the end of the dharma will change into the true dharma. While cultivating, you cannot let thoughts of desire interfere with you. If you have thoughts of desire, you will fall into the end of the Dharma. Therefore, the very important issue here is that there cannot be the mind of competition, the mind of greed, the mind of seeking, the mind of selfishness, the mind of self-interest and the mind of lying.

tieu_de: Explanation of the Structure of the Word 'Dao'
tom_tat: The word 'Dao' includes all things that are vast and indescribable. It is true: "All things are born humanely, one attains spiritual intelligence, fully comprehends the truth, Bodhi does not decrease or increase." Yesterday we talked about the meaning of "Dao," today we talk about the structure...
noi_dung:
Explanation of the Structure of the Word 'Dao'

The word 'Dao' consisting of all things, vast and indescribably mysterious. It is true: "All things are born humanely, one attains spiritual intelligence, fully comprehends the truth, Bodhi does not decrease or increase." Yesterday I explained the meaning of "Dao," Today we'll talk about the structure of the word "Dao."

The structure of Chinese writing is extremely beautiful, each word is a diagram. The structure is based on six methods, which are pictograms, indications, consultation, harmony, repetition and imitation.

Explained in a simplified way, the word Dao belongs to pictograms and consultation. This word "Dao" comes from the word "pipe" and "prime" put together. Tuo means to practice - to go - also to practice. If you don't practice, how can you attain enlightenment? Prime is the head, which also means the highest level. Practicing is the most important thing. If you do not practice, you cannot escape the cycle of birth and death.

Explained thoroughly, it can be said as follows: At the top of the word Dao there are two dots (`'), these two dots represent dharma, the left dot is positive, the right dot is negative. Yang represents heaven, yin represents earth. Yang is universe, yin is wisdom, heaven and earth are universe. Yang belongs to male, yin belongs to female. However, in yang there is yin, in yin there is yang, so men are not always male, sometimes they are born as women. Women do not always have a female body, sometimes they also have a male body. So there are countless changes and miracles that cannot be fully explained.

The two dots just mentioned symbolize heaven and earth, the moon and sun, and the two energies of yin and yang. The human body has negative and positive electricity, blood is yin, and qi is yang. Qi is invisible, blood is tangible. Those two dots are so magical, it's impossible to describe them all.

These two dots can be said to be infinity and tai chi. Infinity is emptiness, taiji is wonderful existence. Due to infinity, tai chi is born, dynamic tai chi gives birth to yang, static tai chi gives birth to yin. When movement reaches its extreme, it becomes stillness. If stillness reaches its extreme, it becomes dynamic. This is a natural rule.

Below the two dots is the first word (- ); Originally it was not the word One (-), it was originally an infinite circle (O) - because it was not the climax, it was just a circle (O). If practiced successfully, this infinite circle will be Great Complete Wisdom; if not successful, it will be ignorance.

The first letter (-) is originally the letter (O). When the time comes, the (O) opens, forming the word One (-). When it turns into the first letter, it begins to have item numbers. When it is still an (O), there is no item number. Please pay special attention to this point: The number of items that do not yet exist is the letter ( O ), when the number of items is available, it becomes the letter 1.

This one word gives birth to heaven, birth to earth, birth to all things, birth to immortals, Buddhas, saints. All things are born from the word one. The letter (O) has nothing, it is a vacuum. When the first word is born, it turns into Wonderful Being, at that time everything is there. The mystery that comes from nothingness becomes wonderful existence, from existence comes nothingness into true emptiness. The truth about emptiness and wonderful existence is truly extremely mysterious.

So, where do we have to look to find that indescribably mysterious religion? Please reply: That is the word "self." Therefore, under the word one, mentioned above, is the word "self," The implication is that seeking the path cannot be sought from outside, because looking outward will not find the right path, but must reflect in the opposite direction - reflect the light back - seek within oneself.

Regarding that [mysterious] realm, in Confucianism there is a saying: "The only star, doan is determined to be loyal." According to Taoism, it is "The foremost treasure," And Buddhism says: "All laws are one." There is a sentence: "All dharmas are one, one is one," the word "match" ( ) includes the word benevolence ( ), the word most ( ) and the word mouth ( ), implying that nothing can be said, which also means closing ( ) the mouth.

That is the moment of separation from speech, separation from writing, separation from the thinking mind, is the realm of "language is cut off, mind action is destroyed," That is, where the path of language ends, where the path of thought ends, so there is nothing left. Some people think: "So doesn't that turn out to be a wooden man?" That's not true. Wooden people don't have a mind, here they do have a mind, but it's a non-action mind, "no action, no action." - do nothing but do everything. This truth cannot be found outside, but we must reflect on ourselves and seek from ourselves, only then can we reach the Way.

Zen school has the following verse:

All dharmas come together, all things come together

The Divine Light of ignorance blocked the Dharma

Hung Nhi mountain front falls nine loads

Just ask for one point of the Yama flower

Translated means: All dharmas return to one, one to the place of union - gathering. Than Quang did not understand clearly and chased after Datma. Kneeling in front of Mount Hung Nhi for nine years, he only prayed for one thing: to escape the King of Hell.
